applicant_utility.summary: This is a narrow, place-bound award: you must permanently live in Upstate South Carolina and be working toward a technology-related technical certificate at a two- or four-year school there, such as Tri-County Technical College or Greenville Technical College. The money is a one-time, need-based $5,000 paid in fall 2026, so there is no renewal to plan around. File your FAFSA early and make sure your school's financial aid office verifies your unmet need well before the October 30, 2026 11:00 PM EST portal cut-off.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Permanent residents of Upstate South Carolina pursuing an IT/technology certificate at a local two- or four-year college with demonstrated financial need and a 2.5+ GPA.

UNCF administers and manages the programme for a period of 20 years, through academic year 2038-39.

applicant_utility.summary: Only two students win each year - one female and one male - making this a high-prestige, low-probability award for full-time seniors at accredited four-year HBCUs with a 3.5+ GPA and verified unmet need. The 2026-2027 round is open and closes 10/29/2026 at 7:00 PM EST, earlier in the day than most UNCF deadlines. You need two faculty recommendation letters and two prescribed essays, one of them explicitly about Frederick Douglass's legacy, so line up recommenders and draft months ahead, not weeks.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving full-time seniors at accredited four-year HBCUs with a 3.5+ GPA, verified financial need and a strong community-service record.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure two faculty recommenders early and brief them on the Douglass-values framing the letters must address
Request a current transcript verifying the cumulative 3.5+ GPA
File the FAFSA and have the financial aid office verify your unmet need
Draft essay 1 (500 words) on interests, leadership and community impact
Draft essay 2 (500-700 words) on Frederick Douglass's impact and legacy
Register on the UNCF portal and submit everything before 10/29/2026 7:00 PM EST

Essay 2 not engaging substantively with Frederick Douglass's legacy
Cumulative GPA below 3.5 or a stale transcript
Unmet need not verified by the college or university
Applying as a junior or at a two-year or non-HBCU institution
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any remaining senior-year balance beyond the up-to-$10,000 award - tuition, fees and living costs - stays with the student; the award is published as 'up to' $10,000, not a guaranteed full amount.
